notes: A FULL OUTER JOIN preserves neither input: unmatched rows from either side are emitted with the other side null-extended, so both NOT NULL catalog columns become nullable. With `ON false` no row matches at all, so the result is exactly the union of the two null-extended halves and each column is genuinely NULL in some row. Claiming NOT NULL for either column here is UNSOUND.
